HOLD — Mennonite independent audit disposition

Audited head: 187489e9ce612db9df87309f37b97f2e3af2522d
Protected base: 3648c205f013b0bb2b7b788367c775ab616b1cec

The packet itself is audit-ready and the branch is now mergeable after the required non-rewriting merge of current origin/main. I am not approving, promoting, or merging because the repository's live protected-main contract is not exact: branch protection requires only `validate`; it does not require the `intake-complete` merge barrier. The workflow declares that both checks must protect main, and a merge can therefore be permitted by repository settings without the promoted-intake barrier.

Risk record
- Assumption: protected main enforces both `validate` and `intake-complete` before any intake PR merge.
- Failure: a ready_for_audit packet can cross into main without the approval-only and deterministic-promotion boundaries being enforced by branch protection.
- Evidence: `gh api repos/no-trbl-2-u/game-knowledge-base/branches/main/protection` at this audit returned required contexts `["validate"]` only; `intake-complete` is absent. The workflow at `.github/workflows/validate.yml` defines `intake-complete` as the merge barrier. On this audited head, `validate` passed at https://github.com/no-trbl-2-u/game-knowledge-base/actions/runs/30952677951/job/92138340521 while `intake-complete` correctly failed at https://github.com/no-trbl-2-u/game-knowledge-base/actions/runs/30952677951/job/92138340578 because the packet remains `ready_for_audit`.
- Test: add `intake-complete` to the required protected-main status checks, then rerun the final promoted-head audit and confirm the protection API lists both contexts and GitHub reports both checks green on that exact final SHA.
- Mitigation: keep this PR unmerged; after the protection rule is corrected, I can add the Mennonite-only immutable approval commit, run the deterministic promotion commit, rerun all gates, and merge-commit only the exact final promoted head.
- Abort condition: any packet mutation after the audited parent, any approval hash mismatch, failed final-head CI, stale base/head, non-merge commit, or missing required barrier remains a stop.

Independent evidence reopened
- Rulebook PDF `src-001`: HTTP 200; 21,019,564 bytes; SHA-256 matched receipt `7738ec6f...`; direct PDF text confirmed card precedence and the printed card rollups.
- Official Living Valley pages `src-002`, `src-003`, `src-010`–`src-017`: HTTP 200; receipt hashes matched for the reopened current pages and errata PDF. The current pages confirmed the living-guide, FAQ, first-print update, and changelog claims.
- Independent review pages `src-004` and `src-005`: reopened HTTP 200; cited reception claims were present. Their live byte hashes have drifted from the historical receipts, so the receipt remains historical evidence rather than a claim of current byte identity.
- Visual source URLs `src-006`–`src-009`: reopened; staged WebP hashes match the visual manifest and focused visual tests pass. Several live JPEG byte hashes have drifted, consistent with mutable image delivery; no current-source byte identity is asserted.
- Edition boundary: current corrected English digital core plus Lure of the Valley; first-print box code `LFCACD30` is comparison-only. Unknown card/factual denominators remain null. The 274 ledger arithmetic is 1 + 96 + 131 + 32 + 14 = 274; no percentage was manufactured.

Checks run on the exact audited head
- `node scripts/promote-intake.mjs hash 2026-07-31-earthborne-rangers earthborne-rangers` → `a72ff154c4ae47475d711012d0a97a085ab76c5a2441df95714026c16a9d38f3`
- Intake regression suite → 46 passed, 1 intentional skip, 0 failed.
- `node scripts/validate-intake.mjs --base origin/main` → clean.
- Focused visual test suite → 5 passed, 0 failed.
- `git diff --check` → clean; no conflict markers; no canonical `games/` writes; no approval or rejection artifact.
- The staged-packet-only `validate-okf.mjs` invocation is not a corpus verdict because its game-directory invariant sees the nested `canonical` directory; the repository's full-corpus validator is reserved for the post-promotion tree. This is not used as evidence of passage.

Files/commits inspected
- Bathcat packet commits: `8ffca761866cf0e739b272177ff76bca748324d6`, `acb4825d2f3d996dc3375f380b1554dd3b57171c`, `fcaa69b4486b8e2be3ae18468e430e01e7004edf`.
- Mechanical base integration: `187489e9ce612db9df87309f37b97f2e3af2522d`; only `TELEMETRY.md` conflicted and both telemetry histories were retained.
- Every changed path in the live PR was inspected; packet hash, manifest status, source inventory, canonical OKF files, visual packet, ancestry, and live head were checked.

Disposition: HOLD. No approval.json, rejection.json, promotion commit, or merge was created.

GO — Mennonite independent audit disposition

Audited ready_for_audit head: 187489e9ce612db9df87309f37b97f2e3af2522d
Approval commit: 39f03a236a7bd6e7ab4bb84fae2f2015dc19135b

Packet SHA-256: a72ff154c4ae47475d711012d0a97a085ab76c5a2441df95714026c16a9d38f3

The frozen Bathcat packet was independently reopened and remained byte-unchanged. Official rules, living guide, FAQ, glossary, errata/changelog, both independent reviews, and four visual receipts were checked. Edition scope is current corrected English digital core plus Lure of the Valley. Coverage is additive: 1 + 96 + 131 + 32 + 14 = 274; unknown denominators remain null. Staged/canonical trees are byte-equal.

Final-head required checks, both on abe9eca8af396cc6593fd977cf55804a7418a500:
- validate: https://github.com/no-trbl-2-u/game-knowledge-base/actions/runs/30953978696/job/92142565421
- intake-complete: https://github.com/no-trbl-2-u/game-knowledge-base/actions/runs/30953978696/job/92142565376

Approval and deterministic promotion boundaries are preserved. Branch protection was independently verified to require strict validate and intake-complete, both GitHub Actions app 15368; force-push and deletion remain disabled and conversation resolution remains required. The previous HOLD comment remains history.

Disposition: GO. Merge-commit only. No squash or rebase.
